title: ALMA resolves giant molecular clouds in a tidal dwarf galaxy
question: How quickly gas condenses into compact structures in a pristine tidal dwarf galaxy, and whether those structures (GMCs) resemble GMCs in the Milky Way and other galaxies

data.arrays: 12 m array + ACA (7 m array + total power antennas)
data.angular_resolution: 12 m: 0.4-0.5 arcsec; 7 m: ~5.4 arcsec; total power: ~28 arcsec; combined cube beam 0.69 x 0.60 arcsec (PA 11 deg), ~45 pc
data.sensitivity: rms ~1 mJy/beam (~56 mK) per 2.5 km/s channel; surface density sensitivity ~3.9 Msun/pc^2 for FWHM = 15 km/s

evidence.quote: To trace atomic gas, we use H I observations from the Very Large Array (VLA), originally published in (cite: 2004ApJ...614..648M).

what.value: IRAM 30 m CO(1-0) observations of the TDG (and global R21 = 0.54 +/- 0.10)

evidence.quote: Those single-dish observations were published by (cite: 2008ApJ...685..181L), and they attained a spatial resolution of $22''$.

what.value: HST WFC3 F547M map of the TDG and NGC 3227

evidence.quote: The map was obtained with the medium-band filter F547M of the WFC3 camera and has been presented in (cite: 2017ApJ...835..271B).

what.value: H-alpha image from the William Herschel Telescope

evidence.quote: We use H$\alpha$ observations of NGC 3227 from the 4.2 m William Herschel Telescope in La Palma, presented in (cite: 2004ApJ...614..648M).
We assume a distance of $14.5 \pm 0.6$ Mpc (cite: 2014ApJ...784L..11Y), based on a new AGN time lag method.

what.value: CO(2-1) conversion factor alpha_CO^2-1 = 4.4 Msun (K km/s pc^2)^-1 (average of resolved nearby galaxy discs)

evidence.quote: which is the average value measured by (cite: 2013ApJ...777....5S) directly on the CO(2-1) line for a set of resolved nearby galaxy discs

what.value: Optically thin HI conversion to column density / surface density (factor 0.0145)

evidence.quote: this is equivalent to multiplying by 0.0145 to transform from K km s$^{-1}$

what.value: Star-forming knot positions and ages used for the GMC-cluster offset comparison

evidence.loc: 4.4 Comparison between GMCs and star formation sites
evidence.quote: Knot 2 was found to be the oldest in (cite: 2008ApJ...685..181L) with ages above $\sim$100 Myr.

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image 12 m + 7 m + total power CO(2-1) cube
recipe.method: Standard calibration, concatenation of 12 m and 7 m visibilities, tclean imaging with the total power cube as model
key_parameters: Hogbom deconvolution, natural weighting, 2 mJy/beam threshold, 2.5 km/s channels
Total power baseline: order-1 polynomial in line-free windows 755-855 and 1500-1600 km/s

recipe.goal: Mask NGC 3227 and build moment maps of the TDG
recipe.method: Mask built from smoothed, clipped HI cube; dilated-mask moment maps (4 sigma seed, 1.5 sigma extension) integrated over 1060-1360 km/s
key_parameters: HI clipped at 3 sigma_sm with sigma_sm = 1 mJy/beam
Line-free range 1360-1450 km/s used for pixel-by-pixel rms

recipe.goal: Convert CO and HI intensities to gas surface densities
recipe.method: Constant alpha_CO^2-1 for CO(2-1); optically thin HI formula
assumptions: Near-solar metallicity of the TDG makes a constant alpha_CO reasonable; includes helium factor 1.36

recipe.goal: Measure H2/HI ratio, diffuse CO fraction and CO(2-1)/CO(1-0) ratio
recipe.method: Measurements at matched 6.3 arcsec using 4 sigma dilated masks; diffuse component = (12m+7m+TP) minus 12m+7m channel by channel; R21 from TP CO(2-1) over IRAM CO(1-0) convolved to 28 arcsec
assumptions: Extended emission is interpreted as diffuse molecular gas

recipe.goal: Identify GMCs with CPROPS (and SCIMES as cross-check)
recipe.method: CPROPS segmentation from a 4 sigma mask expanded to 1.5 sigma, local maxima criteria; SCIMES uses the same mask of significance
key_parameters: Local maxima must be 2 sigma_rms above the merge level
Maxima kept only if associated area exceeds one synthesised beam; islands of 1-2 beams not decomposed
Emission considered where primary beam response >= 20% (~80 x 70 arcsec)

recipe.goal: Derive GMC physical properties (L_CO, R, sigma_v, M_lum, M_vir)
recipe.method: Intensity-weighted moments from the segmentation; moment extrapolation to 0 K and beam deconvolution; bootstrap for uncertainties; unresolved clouds excluded
key_parameters: M_lum = alpha_CO L_CO; M_vir = 1040 sigma_v^2 R (rho proportional to R^-1)
assumptions: alpha_CO^2-1 = 4.4 Msun (K km/s pc^2)^-1; distance 14.5 Mpc; density profile rho proportional to R^-1 for virial mass

recipe.method: Fit cumulative mass distribution with truncated and non-truncated power laws; truncated version preferred
key_parameters: M_GMC = alpha_CO^2-1 L_CO using all CPROPS clouds (extrapolated luminosities); 5 sigma completeness limit 5e4 Msun

recipe.goal: Fit GMC scaling relations (Larson, Heyer plot)
recipe.method: Linear regression in log-log with ODR and with the Bayesian BayesLineFit, on extrapolated and deconvolved properties; Spearman rank correlation

recipe.goal: Compare GMC positions with young star-forming knots and clusters
recipe.method: Overlay GMCs on astrometry-corrected HST F547M and H-alpha images and measure projected offsets from the knots of Lisenfeld et al. 2008
key_parameters: H-alpha astrometry offsets dRA = 0.33 px (0.11 arcsec), dDec = 2.05 px (0.67 arcsec)

answer_key.quantity: Synthesised beam of final cube

evidence.quote: we obtained an average synthesised beam of $0.69" \times 0.60"$ ($\mathrm{PA} = 11^\circ$)

answer_key.quantity: Cube rms brightness sensitivity

evidence.quote: The rms brightness sensitivity of the resulting data cube is $\sigma_{\rm rms} \sim 1$ mJy per beam (${\approx} 56$ mK)

answer_key.quantity: Total molecular gas mass at matched 6.3 arcsec resolution (masked)

evidence.quote: the total molecular gas mass in the TDG is $8.6 \times 10^7$ M$_\odot$, very similar to the total amount of atomic gas ($8.4 \times 10^7$ M$_\odot$)

answer_key.quantity: Total atomic gas mass at matched 6.3 arcsec resolution

evidence.quote: the total molecular gas mass in the TDG is $8.6 \times 10^7$ M$_\odot$, very similar to the total amount of atomic gas ($8.4 \times 10^7$ M$_\odot$)

answer_key.quantity: Total H2/HI mass ratio, north vs south

evidence.quote: the quiescent north has a substantially higher molecular-to-atomic gas ratio (1.47) than the star-forming south (0.37)

answer_key.quantity: Total molecular mass in ALMA cube at native resolution (12m+7m+TP, no mask)

evidence.quote: which is 18% of the total molecular mass (1.63$\times 10^8$ $M_\odot$ in the ALMA cube at native resolution, including total power, and without any masks)

answer_key.quantity: Fraction of CO emission that is extended/diffuse

evidence.quote: it accounts for as much as ${\sim}80{-}90$% of the molecular emission in the TDG

answer_key.quantity: Fraction of 12m+7m+TP flux inside the mask recovered by 12m+7m

evidence.quote: the 12m + 7m cube recovers almost the whole flux (94%) in these compact structures

answer_key.quantity: Global CO(2-1)/CO(1-0) ratio R21

evidence.quote: The average value (masking NGC 3227) is 0.52, in good agreement with the global $R_{21} = 0.54 \pm 0.10$ found by (cite: 2008ApJ...685..181L).

answer_key.quantity: R21 in the south of the TDG

evidence.quote: this becomes particularly extreme towards the south of the TDG ($R_{21} = 0.38$)

answer_key.quantity: Number of GMCs identified with CPROPS

evidence.quote: We find a total of 111 GMCs with CPROPS (out of which 81 have extrapolated and deconvolved values)

answer_key.quantity: Number of SCIMES structures

evidence.quote: SCIMES identified a total of 127 leaves, 49 branches, and 26 trunks in the TDG.

answer_key.quantity: Total molecular gas in GMCs (extrapolated)

evidence.quote: The total molecular gas in GMCs adds up to 3$\times 10^7$ $M_\odot$ (extrapolated to perfect sensitivity)

answer_key.quantity: Virial masses relative to luminous masses

evidence.quote: the virial masses in the TDG are on average ${\sim}1$ dex higher than the luminous masses

answer_key.quantity: Virial parameter, north vs south

evidence.quote: is higher for the clouds in the north (average ${\sim}13$) than for the clouds in the south (average ${\sim}8$)

answer_key.quantity: Cloud-to-cloud velocity dispersion, north vs south

evidence.quote: the relative cloud-to-cloud velocity dispersion is also higher in the north ($\sigma_{\rm cloud-cloud} \sim 73$ km s$^{-1}$) than in the south ($\sigma_{\rm cloud-cloud} \sim 46$ km s$^{-1}$

answer_key.quantity: GMC mass spectrum slope gamma (all GMCs, CPROPS)

evidence.quote: Considering all GMCs in the TDG simultaneously (111 clouds), we find a slope of $\gamma = -1.76 \pm 0.13$.

answer_key.quantity: GMC mass spectrum slope, south vs north

evidence.quote: the south has a shallower mass spectrum, $\gamma = -1.30 \pm 0.19$ instead of $\gamma = -1.76 \pm 0.15$

answer_key.quantity: GMC mass spectrum truncation mass M0

evidence.quote: Fitting all GMCs in the TDG, we found a value of $M_0 = 1.9 \times 10^6$ $M_\odot$.

answer_key.quantity: GMC mass spectrum slope with SCIMES

evidence.quote: the slope of the global truncated power-law fit is slightly higher with SCIMES, $\gamma = -1.84 \pm 0.15$

answer_key.quantity: Size-linewidth relation slope (ODR, whole TDG)

evidence.quote: the slope $\gamma = 2.00 \pm 0.33$ is significantly steeper than the canonical Galactic value of $\sim$0.5

answer_key.quantity: Virial relation slope (ODR, whole TDG)

evidence.quote: The global slope $1.66 \pm 0.13$ is considerably higher than the ${\sim}0.8{-}1$ value found in the Milky Way

answer_key.quantity: Mass-size relation slope (ODR, whole TDG)

evidence.quote: with a global slope of $2.08 \pm 0.19$

Continuum subtraction approach (paper only says no continuum was detected) and line-free channels used for the interferometric cube

Fitting algorithm and uncertainty method for the truncated power-law cumulative mass spectrum

missing_for_reproduction: tclean script and total power combination details
VLA HI cube and the exact NGC 3227 mask
Final GMC catalogue is only partly printed (truncated table)
score_reason: Imaging parameters (CASA 5.4.1, Hogbom, natural weighting, pixel and image size) and GMC derivation formulas are given and project code is stated, but calibration details, TP combination steps, CPROPS/SCIMES settings, fit algorithms and the HI cube are not.
rediscovery_reason: ALMA data come from a Cycle 4 project that should be public in the archive, the CPROPS recipe and mass-spectrum/scaling fits are largely described, and the results are numeric; the NGC 3227 mask needs the VLA HI data.
